PORTFOLIO PRINTING & BINDING

1. Hardcover Binding (Case Binding)
For a premium portfolio, case binding ensures maximum durability and a flat, professional presentation.

The Core: We utilize a rigid 2mm to 3mm imported greyboard for the cover structure to prevent warping.

The Wrap: The cover design is printed on a 130 GSM to 150 GSM liner, which is then tightly wrapped and glued over the board.

The Spine: Can be crafted as a square spine or a rounded spine depending on the page count. For portfolios, a square spine delivers a sleek, modern look.

2. Inside Pages: 170 GSM Imported Stock
170 GSM (Grams per Square Meter) is an ideal "sweet spot" weight for high-end portfolio inner pages. It provides a heavy, distinctively premium feel without being overly stiff.

Imported Quality: Imported art paper features superior opacity, a ultra-smooth surface profile, and high brightness, ensuring exceptional ink holdout and color accuracy.

Matte Coated (Recommended): Eliminates glare, making text highly readable and giving photographic portfolios a sophisticated, editorial look.

We would like to clarify several inaccuracies in the response, as it does not reflect our actual experience.

The shipment arrived on 4th October. From 5th October onward, we were following up regarding one missing jacket. On 8th October, after inspection, defects were identified and immediately raised via WhatsApp and email. We were told the team was occupied with Diwali orders and would respond later.

Concerns were not raised “two weeks later” — they were raised on 8th October itself. The jackets were not used, and we consistently sought resolution. The team only reconnected on 24th October after repeated follow-ups.

We were informed over call that only zips could be addressed and no other issues would be fixed. A refund was requested from the day defects were identified. No comprehensive corrections were carried out.

Additionally, one jacket paid for was not delivered, and no refund has been yet initiated for that.

We are sharing this to ensure transparency so future customers can make informed decisions.
-----------------------------------------------------------
We placed an order for 28 jackets in September for our company offsite. The order was confirmed on 11th September, and full payment was demanded upfront, which we cleared the very next day. Amit (Founder), who coordinated with us, assured timely delivery and confirmed that any color request could be accommodated.

However, until 24th September, the company failed to provide the originally shortlisted fabric color. later were we informed that the chosen color was unavailable for the cuffs, and we eventually agreed to the color they had. At no point during this period were we informed that the jackets would take more than two weeks to procure, despite the team knowing clearly that we needed the jackets by 5th October. Repeated assurances were given that delivery would happen on time.

On 24th September, we were suddenly informed that the jackets would be delivered no earlier than 7th October, citing that production had not yet started and that 2nd and 3rd October were holidays. This was communicated very late and only after multiple follow-ups.

When the jackets were finally delivered, the quality was completely unacceptable:
Cuffs were extremely tight
Collars were misaligned
Loose threads everywhere
Messy, unfinished stitching

Additionally, one jacket was missing, and Amit clearly refused to provide and has yet not refund it.

When we raised concerns and requested corrections, we were asked to pay for the courier to send the jackets back to and fro and on multiple other occasions.  Even after doing so, no corrective work was done.

Since then:
No refund has been issued
The missing jacket has not been compensated
Amit has stopped answering calls neither does he speak over the call
Staff has categorically stated that no money will be refunded yesterday over the call.

What is most disappointing is that despite Amit being a Commander and retired Indian Naval officer, as we see the tag and believed he would be the perfect person to go ahead with which proved us wrong. The business practices followed were highly unethical taking full payment in advance, giving false commitments, refusing accountability, and ultimately ruining an important company event.

I would strongly advise others to exercise extreme caution before engaging with this company.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
We take feedback seriously and would like to clarify the facts for anyone reading this review.

Timelines & Commitments
From the outset, the customer was informed that tailor-made jackets require approximately 3 weeks for manufacturing. The order itself was delayed multiple times from the customer’s side.
When the final confirmation came, we clearly communicated that meeting the required date would be challenging. Despite this, the customer strongly requested us to proceed, citing internal team commitments and reputational concerns.

Exceptional Measures Taken
To support the customer:

We completed manufacturing in just 7 days, which is significantly faster than our standard process.

The shipment was flown by air at our own cost to minimize delays.

A physical sample was shared and approved, and the final jackets were manufactured to match that sample.

Delivery & Acceptance

Jackets had individual names printed, and the shipment was checked by the customer’s team member before acceptance.

No issues were raised at the time of delivery or immediately thereafter.

Post-Event Complaints & Resolution Efforts
Nearly two weeks after the event and after usage, concerns were raised regarding zips and stray threads.
Despite the jackets showing signs of regular use, we:

Collected all jackets back

Inspected each piece

Corrected zips that had been incorrectly pulled during use

Returned the jackets after another round of individual inspection by the customer’s team member

Refund Request
After all corrections were completed and jackets were re-accepted, a full refund was requested. At this stage, there were no unresolved manufacturing defects, and the jackets had already been used for the event.
Under these circumstances, a refund is not reasonable or aligned with standard custom-manufacturing practices.

Communication
At no point did we refuse communication. Our team has responded whenever contacted.
Threats of negative reviews in exchange for refunds are neither ethical nor constructive.

We stand by the quality of our work and by the fact that we went well beyond normal obligations to support this order under extreme time pressure.
That said, we regret that the experience did not meet the customer’s expectations and remain open to resolving concerns fairly and professionally.
